-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

create-spreadsheet.name: create-spreadsheet
create-spreadsheet.description: Create a new Google Spreadsheet with a title and optional initial data. Returns the spreadsheet ID and URL.

params.title: Title of the new spreadsheet
params.sheets: Optional: names of sheets (tabs) to create. Defaults to a single "Sheet1".

write-values.name: write-values
write-values.description: Write data to a specific range in a Google Sheet. Overwrites existing values. Pass a 2D array of rows (each row is an array of cell values). Supports formulas (strings starting with =).

params.range: A1 notation range to write to (e.g. "Sheet1!A1:C3" or "A1:C3")
params.values: 2D array of rows. Each row is an array of cell values (string, number, or boolean).

append-values.name: append-values
append-values.description: Append rows of data to the end of a sheet in a Google Spreadsheet. Finds the last row with data and appends below it. Supports formulas (strings starting with =).

params.range: A1 notation range to start appending from (e.g. "Sheet1!A1" or "A1"). The API finds the last row with data in this range and appends below.
params.values: 2D array of rows to append. Each row is an array of cell values.

batch-update.name: batch-update
batch-update.description: Execute advanced operations on a Google Spreadsheet using the Sheets API batchUpdate endpoint. Supports: adding/deleting/renaming sheets, cell formatting (bold, colors, borders, number format), conditional formatting, formulas, frozen rows/columns, data validation, protected ranges, and more. Pass an array of request objects following the Google Sheets API batchUpdate schema.

params.requests: Array of batchUpdate request objects. Each object is a key mapped to its request type. Common types: addSheet, deleteSheet, updateSheetProperties (rename, tabColor, gridProperties like frozenRowCount), repeatCell (formatting: textFormat with bold/italic/fontSize/foregroundColor, backgroundColor, numberFormat, borders), addConditionalFormatRule, setDataValidation, addProtectedRange, autoResizeDimensions, updateBorders, mergeCells, unmergeCells, addChart, addPivotTable. See https://developers.google.com/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request for full schema.

read-spreadsheet.name: read-spreadsheet
read-spreadsheet.description: Read data from a Google Sheet.

params.range: The range to read (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:D10', default: first sheet)

read-sheet-range.name: read-sheet-range
read-sheet-range.description: Read a specific range from a Google Sheet. More efficient than reading the entire sheet.

params.fileId: ID of the Google Sheet file
params.range: Range to read in A1 notation (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:D10', 'Sheet2!A:A')
params.valueRenderOption: How to render values: FORMATTED_VALUE (default), UNFORMATTED_VALUE, or FORMULA

list-sheet-tabs.name: list-sheet-tabs
list-sheet-tabs.description: List all sheets (tabs) in a Google Spreadsheet with their metadata.

params.fileId: ID of the Google Sheet file

export-sheet.name: export-sheet
export-sheet.description: Export a Google Sheet to a specific format (CSV, XLSX, PDF, ODS, TSV). Downloads the exported file to local filesystem.

params.fileId: ID of the Google Sheet file to export
params.format: Export format: csv, xlsx, pdf, ods, tsv (default: csv)
params.outputPath: Optional: Local path where to save the exported file. Defaults to ~/Downloads/
params.sheetName: Optional: Name of specific sheet to export (for CSV/TSV only). If not provided, exports first sheet.

name: Google Sheets
description: Create, read, write, append, format, and export Google Sheets spreadsheets - create, write data, append rows, batch update (formatting, formulas, conditional formatting), read data, ranges, list tabs, export to CSV/XLSX/PDF. To delete a spreadsheet, use the Google Drive MCA.
